description: This file contains the implementation of the Transaction controller class within the Opencart SDK, responsible for handling account transaction-related endpoints in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages user authentication, retrieves transaction data, handles pagination, and prepares data for rendering the transaction view.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Controller class for managing account transactions, including listing, pagination, and access control within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main logic for displaying the user's transaction history page, including authentication checks, data retrieval, pagination, and rendering the view.
